name: Texture Co-occurrence Matrix Log (GLCM)
description: The twin-pulse radar counting machine. Across ten thousand pixels, if two neighboring pixels separated by distance X share identical luminance, they are cataloged strictly into a ledger. In the organic physical world, 'Object A next to Object B' occurs organically according to chaotic but smooth statistical laws (genuine rough clouds, authentically coarse skin). AI hallucinations and heavy-handed Photoshop brush smoothing aggressively cause this ledger to log horrific anomalies... manifesting textures as flat as a UFO, entirely bereft of the erratic, jagged twin-pair values organic reality produces.
mechanism: The algorithm physically rolls out the image canvas grid. It interrogates twin-pairs specifically separated by an angle D and Distance r. GLCM instantly manifests dozens of ledgers tracking the Contrast, Energy, and Homogeneity of the specific pair. AI is catastrophically ignorant of true micro-textures. It paints a sweater, but forces the wool fibers to look waxy or blatantly copy-pasted (Texture Clones). This synthetic repetition causes Homogeneity ledgers to spike unnaturally, while Differences spectacularly plummet to zero. The radar violently inhales this unmistakable 'Plastic Look' and issues a guilty verdict.
parameters: Holding Cell: Grayscale GLCM Matrix, Vector Execution: Energy, Contrast, Entropy, Homogeneity Metrics
accuracy: Elite Sniper (78-86%) - A silent assassin designed to devour amateurs utilizing Copy-Move tools to repeat foliage or frantically erase freckles from facial portraits.
source: Haralick et al. (1973) - Textural Features for Image Classification & Spatial Matrix Forensics
useCase: Brings the executioner's sledgehammer violently crashing down upon supposed artistic masterpieces where malicious 'Beautify' (Retouching) apps slice through human skin... utterly annihilating organic pores and rendering the entire GLCM matrix completely, artificially numb.

references.title: Haralick, R. M., et al. (1973). Textural features for image classification. IEEE TSMC.
Haralick, R.M. et al. (1973). Textural Features for Image Classification. IEEE TSMC.
Clausi, D.A. (2002). An Analysis of Co-occurrence Texture Statistics. Canadian J. Remote Sensing.
Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Entirely invincible to all chromatic hacking or color-grading manipulation. The matrix interrogates specific coupled 'Light-Dark' pores independent of color wavelength, making it completely immune to color filters.
• The supreme apex predator hunting generative AI clothing patterns. If an AI hallucinates a mathematically repetitive, cloned fabric texture... the GLCM alarm sounds a forgery execution immediately.
limitations:
• The precision blade swings wildly (triggering catastrophic False Positives) if the target image physically depicts highly reflective, glossy satin silk. Real physical uniformity artificially triggers the exact same numb response as AI smoothing.
• Horrifically sluggish and paralyzingly slow. If forced to calculate multi-distance and multi-angular matrices across a colossal 4K canvas, the algorithm chokes on computational exhaustion.
